{{Quote|The ion storms of Moorja have prevented the deployment of our standard battle-droid forces, but Neimoidian Gunnery Battalions, Gossam Commandos and Koorivar Fusiliers have consolidated to provide Moorja with cost-effective protective forces.|Commerce Guild Presidente Shu Mai|<ref name="CIS" />}}
'''Moorja''' was a small [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] on the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]]. It was owned by the [[Salliche Agricultural Corporation]], which ran an agricultural and [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colony there. Though the planet was frequently swept by fierce [[Ion storm/Legends|ion storms]] capable of interfering with electronic equipment, it was a major exporter of foodstuffs.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] established a [[Moorjan Confederate base|base]] on the planet, gathering soil from its [[Badlands (Moorja)|badlands]], which it then utilized during its [[Battle of Ukio|assault]] on [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]]. The Confederacy later conquered the planet and [[Garrison/Legends|garrisoned]] it with organic forces, a rare move for the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]]-focused government. While there, the CIS fought the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the [[Battle of Moorja]]. The planet subsequently became part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and home to an advanced [[Scout/Legends|scout]] training facility. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the planet was the site of another [[Battle of Moorja (Galactic Civil War)|major engagement]], between forces of the Empire and the rogue [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Utoxx Prentioch]]; both were attempting to gain access to a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] reconnaissance report prepared by the [[Black Curs]]. Later that same year, the New Republic [[Seizure of Moorja|gained]] control of the planet, establishing a [[New Republic Moorjan base|permanent base]], and using it as a jumping point for assaults against various Imperial forces.

==Description==
{{Quote|This world is worse than all Nine Corellian Hells put together&hellip; and yet it has what we need.|Passel Argente|<ref name="Instinct" />}}
Moorja was a small [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Moorja system/Legends|Moorja system]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]],<ref name="BCB" /> down the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] from [[Yag'Dhul/Legends|Yag'Dhul]].<ref name="CIS" /> It had one moon,<ref name="Instinct" /> and a local day consisting of seventeen standard hours, and a year of 310 local days. The terrain varied from fertile plains and forests to a number of desolate [[Badlands (Moorja)|badlands]]. Notable among these badlands were the [[Crumbling Lands]], a region of sedimentary rock strata undermined over many years by [[Water/Legends|water]] erosion. Many caves and tunnels crisscrossed the area, while sandstone formations and deep sinkholes dominated the surface.<ref name="BCB" /> The soil in the Moorja badlands was an electrostatic compound with photosensitive properties.<ref name="Instinct" />

[[File:Moorja_badlands.png|thumb|left|200px|Badlands of Moorja]]
In contrast to these barren regions, most of Moorja's surface was naturally fertile, aided by plentiful rainfall from the frequent [[Ion storm/Legends|ion storms]] that blew in from the world's [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]]. However, poor crop management had taxed this fertility, leaving many areas dependent on artificially produced fertilizer. Nevertheless, Moorja produced sufficient crops of [[fenti bean]]s and [[ruva]] grain to export offworld.<ref name="BCB" />

The planet was home to no native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The most distinctive creatures there were the [[bruwose]]s, immense lizards that inhabited the badlands. Equipped with large fore-paw talons, the reptiles burrowed through the soft rock, searching for small prey. The bruwoses possessed only vestigial eyes, instead using heat, sound and smell for guidance.<ref name="BCB" />

A frequent recurrence on Moorja were ion storms. These lightning storms heavily interfered with electronic equipment, and ion lightning strikes damaged [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]], [[Life support/Legends|life support]], nav-control and other important [[Starship/Legends|starship]] systems, rendering planetary landings extremely difficult. To counteract this, most of Moorja's [[Farm/Legends|farming]] equipment was earthed, however, machinery still needed to be replaced often.<ref name="BCB" />

==History==
===Galactic Republic===
{{Quote|If you peruse the attached profit-and-loss schema in your folders, you'll see that in this case, the distribution of organic personnel in this combat market has proven to be more affordable than refitting existing capital goods with ionic-damping technologies.|Commerce Guild Presidente Shu Mai|<ref name="CIS" />}}
[[File:CIS_Troops.jpg|thumb|left|200px|CIS troops land on Moorja]]
Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], near the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="TCWn">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]] links into ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' and places it around 22 BBY. Bolla Ropal's death in the ''Act on Instinct'' is referenced in ''The Clone Wars'' series thus tying the events to this year.</ref> the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] established a [[Moorjan Confederate base|presence]] in the Moorja badlands, under the command of [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]] [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]] of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]], and his assistant [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]], [[Doctor (tactical droid)|Doctor]]. The Doctor had developed [[Project Instinction]], an operative designed to neutralize the [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] of [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]]. The Confederacy utilized four [[Seismic tank/Legends|seismic tanks]] to collect soil from the Moorja badlands. The Confederacy took advantage of its photosensitive properties by [[Battle of Ukio|dumping]] large amounts of soil into Ukio's atmosphere. There, it stuck to the planet's defensive shields, drifting to stay in line with the planet's star, creating a moving eclipse designed to block sunlight from the surface and destroy the planet's crops.<ref name="Instinct" />

In the later years of the Clone Wars, circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the Confederacy gained control of the entire Corellian Trade Spine, including Moorja, after an extended campaign known as [[Operation Durge's Lance]]. The Confederacy then opted to fortify Moorja in order to protect the "back door" of their recent conquest. However, the frequent ion storms that swept the planet prevented a cost-effective deployment of the Confederacy's standard [[Droid/Legends|droid]] forces. As such, a combined force of organic [[Troop/Legends|troops]], made up of [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Neimoidian Gunnery Battalion|Gunnery Battalions]], [[Gossam/Legends|Gossam]] [[Gossam Commandos/Legends|Commandos]], and [[Koorivar/Legends|Koorivar]] [[Koorivar Fusiliers/Legends|Fusiliers]], was stationed on the planet, in a move announced by [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] [[Presidente/Legends|Presidente]] [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]]. The cost of the unusual move was offset by the availability of agrarian yields to feed the troops.<ref name="CIS" /> While planetside, the Fusiliers took part in the [[Battle of Moorja]] under the command of the famous [[General/Legends|General]] [[Oro Dassyne/Legends|Oro Dassyne]].<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> The Koorivar General went on to lead troops in the ruinous [[Battle of Bomis Koori IV]].<ref name="CW">{{CW|22}}</ref>

===Galactic Empire===
{{Quote|Throw down your weapons and surrender. You're under arrest for ship-jacking an Imperial shuttle.|Colonel Dyrra|<ref name="TLH" />}}
With the defeat of the Confederacy and the subsequent [[Declaration of a New Order|declaration]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], control of Moorja switched hands to the new [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] power. The [[Salliche Agricultural Corporation]], an Imperial agricultural conglomerate, governed the planet, although so long as the colony paid its taxes and produce exports continued, supervision was limited.<ref name="BCB" /> The Empire also established an advanced [[Scout trooper/Legends|Scout trooper]] training camp in one of the more remote regions of the planet; Moorja was selected as a [[Politics/Legends|political]] favor to an officer of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] that hailed from the colony. The scout base was largely kept a secret from the planet's inhabitants, although a small garrison was established on the planet to keep peace in the urban centers.<ref name="TLH" />

[[File:Moorja_installation.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Moorja scout training installation]]
The training facility offered refresher courses for Imperial units who were rotated out on a weekly basis. While the facility was under the command of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Dyrra]], a group of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] broke into the facility and stole a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]]. Fighting off the troops stationed there, and a number of training [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]], the thieves piloted the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] straight into an ion storm and into [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]]. There, they avoided an Imperial [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] and its [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] patrols and escaped into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. Dyrra, however, was not content to end the pursuit. Tracking the thieves to the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], he ambushed them in their [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] [[Docking Bay 118|docking bay]]. Despite this advantage, the thieves managed to escape the colonel a second time.<ref name="TLH" />

While the Empire suffered a major defeat by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the defeat had little impact on Moorja. Even the rising unrest across the Salliche Ag conglomerate&mdash;where many workers rebelled, burning fields and farming facilities on multiple worlds<ref name="SWAJ">{{JournalCite|2|Recon & Report: The Journey to Coruscant}}</ref>&mdash;had limited effect on the populace, who continued their lives as though nothing had changed. However, despite the planet's momentary inconsequence, it was the site of a [[Battle of Moorja (Galactic Civil War)|large skirmish]] between warring Imperial factions in [[4 ABY/Legends|39:9]], six months after the Battle of Endor.<ref name="BCB" />

[[File:Bruwose.png|thumb|right|200px|A [[bruwose]] attacks a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] operative.]]
The cause was [[Dirk Harkness]], a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] and Rebel sympathizer, who had conducted an extensive reconnaissance of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] as a precursor to a major Rebel offensive in the central galactic region. Before departing on his mission, he had stashed a cache of equipment in the Crumbling Lands of Moorja. His mission having been discovered by the [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisors]] in the Core, he returned to the planet pursued by two of their Star Destroyers under the command of [[Bregius Golthan]]. However, Goltan's forces were met in the [[Star system/Legends|system]] by two Star Destroyers commanded by the [[Warlord/Legends|Imperial Warlord]] [[Utoxx Prentioch]]. Prentioch, a former [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] and pretender to the Imperial throne who was carving out his own [[Prentioch's Dominion|Dominion]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], sought Harkness's recon report for his own gains. While the [[Warship/Legends|warships]] exchanged salvos, Harkness and his companions aboard the [[Last Chance (YT-1300 light freighter)/Legends|''Last Chance'']] were stuck by [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] fire and crash-landed on the planet.<ref name="BCB" />

Fortunately for Harkness and his team, General [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]], chief of the [[New Republic Intelligence Service]], was aware of their pursuit. His team, dispatched to provide aid to the mercenaries, arrived in the Moorja system just as the ''Last Chance'' descended to the planet's surface. Competing with two sets of Imperial [[Dropship/Legends|dropships]], the operatives reached the downed mercenaries first. While Harkness's companions&mdash;[[Platt Okeefe/Legends|Platt Okeefe]], [[Tru'eb Cholakk]], and [[Jai Raventhorn]]&mdash;were at the ship, Harkness himself had set off across the Crumbling Lands to retrieve a [[Snubfighter/Legends|snubfighter]] he had stashed there. Tracking Harkness through the wastelands, they caught up to him outside the tunnel leading to his ship. However, blocking the entrance to the tunnel were three bruwoses, which the operatives were forced to kill in order to gain access to Harkness's ship. Once they had done so, they retrieved Harkness's [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] and regrouped with the crew of the ''Last Chance''. Together they fled the planet, evading fighters from the battle still occurring in Moorja space.<ref name="BCB" />

Later that same year,<ref>In this article, the events in "[[Black Curs Blues]]" have been placed before the events told in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' as there is no New Republic base on Moorja in "Black Curs Blues".</ref> the New Republic successfully [[Seizure of Moorja|wrested]] control of Moorja from Imperial forces, as part of their strategy of isolating various Imperial warlords, and established a permanent [[New Republic Moorjan base|presence]] on the world. The following [[5 ABY/Legends|year]], the Republic pushed Coreward from Moorja, striking at [[Battle of Yag'Dhul (Galactic Civil War)|Yag'Dhul]] against [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Sander Delvardus]] of the [[Eriadu Authority]], and in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], a Republic strikeforce from Moorja [[Siege of Bomis Koori|struck]] southwest at [[Bomis Koori IV|Bomis Koori]], taking Prentioch captive.<ref name="TEA" />

===Later history===
Moorja escaped the worst of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] of [[25 ABY/Legends|25]]&ndash;[[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], being on the far side of the [[Vector Prime|invasion vector]] of the extra-galactic [[Yuuzhan Vong]]'s assault path, and remained in Republic hands. More than a century later, however, the planet was part of [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
Though Moorja had no native sentient species, it was settled by a number of species under the auspices of the Salliche Ag Corporation. A small colony of [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] settled the planet, working in [[Salt/Legends|salt]] [[Mining/Legends|mines]]. By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], they numbered 2,500, most of whom had some degree of salt addiction. Around 15,000 [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]] lived on the planet, settling around a number of forested regions, where they harvested specialty fruits and low yield crops for export. 25,000 [[Human/Legends|Human]] settlers made up the remainder of the planet's permanent population.<ref name="BCB" />

During the Clone Wars, a number of Gossam, Koorivar, and Neimoidians were stationed on the planet, but none remained on the planet in the decades afterwards.<ref name="CIS" /><ref name="BCB" />

==Locations==
===Confederate base===
During the Clone Wars, the Confederacy established a base in the mountains overlooking some of Moorja's badlands. From there, the Doctor was able to monitor the progress of the seismic tanks under his command. He occupied the installation, along with his pet [[Seventeen]], and Magistrate Passel Argente, until leaving the planet to assault Ukio.<ref name="Instinct" />

===Moorjay===
[[Moorjay]] was the sole [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the planet and the only major settlement. It was an undisturbed environment, surrounded by millions of acres of farmland and fields. A number of smaller agrarian settlements were dotted around the spaceport,<ref name="BCB" /> such as the settlement of [[Avisio]].<ref name="CIS" />

===Moorja Training Installation===
The [[Moorja Training Installation]] was designed to provide refresher courses for squads from different [[Sector fleet/Legends|Sector Fleets]]. It was located in a remote region of the planet, on the edge of crumbling badlands. The outpost contained limited facilities: a [[command bunker]], two modular [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]], various storage sheds, a mess hall and a motor pool. A flat area was also cleared to provide landing facilities.<ref name="TLH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Moorja was created by [[Peter M. Schweighofer]] for the [[roleplaying game]] adventure ''[[Black Curs Blues]]'', published in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 8|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 8]] in [[1995]]. There, it served as the setting for the first part of the adventure, which eventually moved offworld to [[Canyon]] and [[Voktunma]]. Schweighofer revisited the planet as part of the adventure ''[[The Lambda Heist]]'' in [[Star Wars Gamer 2|''Star Wars Gamer'' 2]], published in [[2001]]. Again, it was the setting for one part of a larger adventure. The third appearance of the planet was in ''[[CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 15:3:21 Edition]]'', published in the [[Star Wars Insider 76|''Star Wars Insider'' 76]] magazine in [[2004]]. Moorja also briefly appeared in the online [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] ''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]''.

Moorja was initially placed in the Inner Rim region by Schweighofer, but was described as a Mid Rim world by ''Insider'' magazine. Despite this, both maps in which it has been placed and the ''Star Wars Gamer'' adventure all returned it to the Inner Rim. It is worth noting that in ''Black Curs Blues'', the travel time from the position of the New Republic fleet near [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], to Moorja was stated to be "only a few hours." Since that publication, maps of the galaxy have been published with Mon Calamari on the other side of the galaxy from the Corellian Trade Spine, rendering this travel time unlikely.
